name: Tide Classic
idea: Tide's tile recoloured cyan to deep blue; solid white lines. The baseline to compare against.

name: Clearwater
idea: Same tile; the lines are 75% white, so the gradient shows through them.

name: Glass Tide
idea: Deep blue to cyan, reversed; every line is a frosted tube with a bright rim and a clear core.

name: Deep Sea
idea: Navy lit by a cyan glow from above; glass lines tinted from white to cyan.

name: Depth
idea: Cyan surface falling to deep blue; translucent lines with an open, outlined core like Tide's bell.

name: Midnight
idea: Near-black navy with a cyan rim of light; cyan-tinted translucent lines.

name: Aurora
idea: Deep blue with cyan and azure glows in the corners, as Misty's field does; glass lines.

name: Lagoon
idea: The brightest: cyan to azure; 88% white lines with a deeper shadow for lift.
